item.title: Whiskers 0.8.23
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.23

### Bulk Transcription

  • Redesigned the Bulk Transcription page with drag-and-drop upload and expandable file cards
  • Choose from downloaded on-device models and per-provider cloud model options
  • Play back audio with a waveform scrubber, and copy or export transcripts to TXT or SRT
  • Apply AI Enhancement prompts to bulk transcripts (when enabled), with prompt management built in
  • Bulk transcription results now persist across navigation and app restarts

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed the start cue playing through the wrong output device
